entities.name: The Government of Andhra Pradesh will provide only salary for the medical and non-medical staff, transferred with the existing hospital, for two years from the 'Effective Date'.

The Concessionaire is required to assess the provision of additional staff (medical, non- medical, para medical etc) needed as per NMC norms for hospital and medical college and bear the Cost of provision of such additional staff.
The Government of Andhra Pradesh will not provide any operation and maintenance grant or bear any expense thereof for running and operation of hospital and medical college.
Allocation of Land for each project

Government have issued orders for development of 10 new medical colleges at Adoni, Madanapalli, Markapuram, Pulivendula, Penugonda, Palakollu, Amalapuram, Narsipatnam, Bapatla and Parvathipuram under PPP mode
The remaining six (6) medical colleges will be taken up immediately after finalization of the Feasibility Reports, Draft RFPs and Concession Agreements.
The Tender Committee was permitted to make minor modifications to the RFPs based on pre-bid consultations.
the MD, APMSIDC has informed that two pre-bid consultations held on 06.10.2025 and 23.10.2025.
The PPP Committee constituted vide G.O. 2ⁿᵈ read above, has been met on 13.11.2025 and discussed in detail about the responses to be given to the pre-bid queries received.
The PPP Committee have discussed deliberately and drafted the responses against each of queries.
The Committee have opined that the following issues requires approval of the Government before publishing the same in e-procurement platform: Allocation of Land for each project
